[ Five laws of the machine ]

How a network learns to see, speak & dream

LAW 01INPUT

Everything is a number

Words become tokens, pixels become brightness values, sound becomes pressure samples. Before a model can think about the world, the world must be flattened into arithmetic.

LAW 02WEIGHTS

Knowledge is a weight

A connection carries a number that says how much to care. Multiply, sum, repeat a few trillion times — that's not a metaphor for understanding. In these systems, that is understanding.

LAW 03ACTIVATION

Neurons vote, nonlinearly

An activation function decides whether a neuron fires. Without this small nonlinearity, a thousand layers would collapse into one boring equation. Curvature is where intelligence hides.

LAW 04BACKPROP

Error flows backward

When the network guesses wrong, blame travels backwards through every layer, nudging every weight by a tiny gradient. Do this a few billion times and chaos becomes competence.

LAW 05EMERGENCE

Nobody programmed this

At sufficient scale, abilities appear that no engineer designed: translation, reasoning, code. We built the vessel. The capabilities emerged on their own — and we're still writing the safety manual.
